newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Blue chips bump Swedish shares ahead at close.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips bump Swedish shares ahead at close.

text.p: Swedish share prices edged higher on Monday, lifted by gains in blue chips Astra and Ericsson.
The bourse's general index rose 0.22 percent to 2,656.51 in turnover totalling three billion crowns.
"This has been a very quiet day with low turnover," a trader said. "Nothing exciting happened on the company reporting side either -- AGA came in according to expectations."
Medical and industrial gas group AGA slipped 0.5 to 107.5 after posting a 1996 profit after financial items of 1.76 billion crowns, excluding capital gains.
Swedish Match also presented a 1996 profit in line with expectations and edged 0.10 crown lower to 26.6 crowns.
Pharmaceutical group Astra rose four crowns to 364, while telecoms group Ericsson advanced 2.5 crowns to 241.
Auotmotive group Volvo rode on positive newspaper articles and rose three to 191 crowns.
The banking and insurance sector belonged to the losers, the index falling 0.50 percent.
Holding company Industrivarden gained three crowns to 380 ahead of releasing 1996 earnings on Tuesday.
